reason: The only material unresolved boundary after the GWTC-5.0 calibration was release/triad portability, and the frozen GWTC-4.1 all-44 transport test has now answered that bounded question.

Trying additional predictors, subsets, parameters, model triads or directions on the now-unblinded GWTC-4.1 outcomes would be post-result optimization with substantial overlap and little independent value.
An exact-triad strict replication is not possible in GWTC-4.1 because IMRPhenomXPNR is absent.
The remaining scientifically cleaner step requires a genuinely new public release or new disjoint cohort with a frozen compatible contract before target values are accessed.
